publications.title: Key Parameters of Tumor Epitope Immunogenicity Revealed Through a Consortium Approach Improve Neoantigen Prediction.
publications.scopeAndLimits: Five complete body paragraphs plus complete abstract. Validation uses class-I HLA binding and patient-matched multimer-based detection of pre-existing T-cell specificities. Small somatic variants were considered; fusion and splice sources, class-II responses, allogeneic rules and vaccination-induced specificities were not validated by these experiments. Introductory broad safety/effectiveness language is not adopted.

publications.title: A large peptidome dataset improves HLA class I epitope prediction across most of the human population.
crossrefTitle: A large peptidome dataset improves HLA class I epitope prediction across most of the human population
publications.scopeAndLimits: Four complete body paragraphs plus complete abstract. Mono-allelic class-I recovery, allele-specific motifs and HLA immunopurification support the assay distinction. Dissociated mixed tissue does not itself assign each peptide to a source cell. No all-proteins/all-cells universal presentation claim or assay-performance figure is adopted.

publications.title: Escape from nonsense-mediated decay associates with anti-tumor immunogenicity.
crossrefTitle: Escape from nonsense-mediated decay associates with anti-tumor immunogenicity
publications.scopeAndLimits: Two complete results paragraphs plus complete abstract. Frameshift expression and prior functional screening are scoped to their datasets. The descriptive mass-spectrum example supports mutant protein expression, not by itself HLA display. Broad NK-attraction shorthand and general splice-source validation are not adopted.

publications.title: Identification of a Titin-derived HLA-A1-presented peptide as a cross-reactive target for engineered MAGE A3-directed T cells.
crossrefTitle: Identification of a Titin-Derived HLA-A1–Presented Peptide as a Cross-Reactive Target for Engineered MAGE A3–Directed T Cells
publications.scopeAndLimits: Complete abstract only. One affinity-enhanced MAGE-A3-directed receptor programme and a titin-derived alternative target, with the authors most-likely causal interpretation. No whole-paper, original-figure, toxicity-rate or pan-receptor safety claim. Rate-limited XML and challenged HTML were not article reads.

publications.title: Neoantigen quality predicts immunoediting in survivors of pancreatic cancer.
crossrefTitle: Neoantigen quality predicts immunoediting in survivors of pancreatic cancer
publications.scopeAndLimits: Complete abstract only. Neoantigen-quality modelling of human pancreatic cancer evolution; a model about immunoediting is not a universal prospective safety or identity threshold. No whole-body read or model reimplementation.

publications.title: Neoantigens in cancer immunotherapy.
publications.scopeAndLimits: Complete abstract only. General neoantigen immune-recognition context; underlying cited studies were not read through this review, and no new clinical benefit claim is adopted.

publications.title: Regulatory T cells in dominant immunologic tolerance.
crossrefTitle: Regulatory T cells in dominant immunologic tolerance
publications.scopeAndLimits: Complete abstract only. Treg contribution to peripheral tolerance is used at review scope. Online September 2023 and print 2024 dates remain distinct; no tissue-repair or therapeutic efficacy claim is adopted.

publications.title: T-cell tolerance: central and peripheral.
publications.scopeAndLimits: Complete abstract only. Central deletion/diversion and peripheral anergy/deletion mechanisms, with incomplete central restraint, are review statements. Underlying primary mouse experiments are not newly re-verified here. Challenged HTML and rate-limited XML were not body reads.

registryScope: Eight Europe PMC identities agree with intended papers; seven Crossref records agree on normalized title, DOI and first-author family. The Wells Crossref request returned 429. Online and print dates remain distinct. No blanket no-retractions/no-corrections certification.
discoveryScope: Four primary-site discovery queries and two PMC lead opens; results were leads only. All adopted publication identities were resolved from raw registry responses.
